summary: Bluerock Homes Trust, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of a series of dispositions of 24 single-family residential units from its Ballast portfolio (Arizona, Colorado, Washington) to unaffiliated third parties. The aggregate sales price was approximately $8.5 million, yielding net proceeds of $7.8 million after closing costs and adjustments. The dispositions occurred over January 1–June 2, 2026. The registrant holds a 95% interest in the joint venture that owned the portfolio. No board recommendation or advisor is mentioned. The filing includes unaudited pro forma financial statements. This is a routine asset sale, not a transformative special situation; the aggregate value is modest relative to the company.
